# args: 
antctl is the command line tool for Antrea that supports showing status of controller

Usage:
  antctl [command]

Available Commands:
  check         Performs pre and post installation checks
  completion    Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  get           Get the status or resource of a topic
  help          Help about any command
  mc            Sub-commands of multi-cluster feature
  packetcapture Start capture packets
  proxy         Run a reverse proxy to access Antrea API
  query         Execute a user-provided query
  supportbundle Generate support bundle
  traceflow     Start a Traceflows
  upgrade       Sub-commands for upgrade operations
  version       Print version information

Flags:
  -h, --help                help for antctl
  -k, --kubeconfig string   absolute path to the kubeconfig file
  -s, --server string       address and port of the API server, taking precedence over the default endpoint and the one set in kubeconfig
  -t, --timeout duration    time limit of the execution of the command
  -v, --verbose             enable verbose output

Use "antctl [command] --help" for more information about a command.
